ref: By midnight, he will have cried more tears than a whole telenovela!
sk: Do polnoci vyroní viac sĺz než celá telenovela!

ref: The woman who brought the bouquet also carries a bottle.
sk: Žena, ktorá priniesla kyticu, nesie aj fľašu.

ref: This heat is too much for me!
sk: Táto horúčava je na mňa priveľa!

ref: They will light the candles once the last plates are on the fresh cloth.
sk: Sviečky zapália, len čo posledné taniere budú na čerstvom obruse.

ref: The barista decided to display the sponge cake under a glass dome.
sk: Barista sa rozhodol vystaviť piškótovú tortu pod sklenený poklop.

ref: His shout is louder than her shout.
sk: Jeho výkrik je hlasnejší ako jej.

ref: Yo, Why is the water so smooth? 'Cause there's no wind.
sk: Hej, prečo je voda taká hladká? Lebo nefúka vietor.

ref: The big pink rose is soft and fresh.
sk: Veľká ružová ruža je jemná a čerstvá.

ref: Twenty straw hats hang at the stall.
sk: V stánku visí dvadsať slamených klobúkov

ref: Twenty straw hats are hanging at the stall.
sk: V stánku visí dvadsať slamených klobúkov

ref: He's getting his briefcase checked at the gallery door, obviously a very relaxed visit.
sk: Pri dverách galérie si dáva aktovku skontrolovať, očividne veľmi uvoľnená návšteva.

ref: Bro, she is fastening the bracelet on her bestie's wrist right now, no cap.
sk: Kámo, ona práve zapína náramok na zápästí svojej najlepšej kámošky, bez kecov.

ref: The quarry, which was full of dust after the scene, is used for many films.
sk: Lom, ktorý bol po scéne plný prachu, sa používa v mnohých filmoch.

ref: Right now she is closing the lid of the box.
sk: Práve teraz zatvára vrchnák krabice.

ref: The producer asked where they had filmed that dolly shot.
sk: Producent sa spýtal, kde natočili ten záber s vozíkom.

ref: Honestly, you will reach the top of this frozen wall in minutes.
sk: Úprimne, ty dosiahneš vrchol tejto zamrznutej steny za pár minút.

ref: Two more penguins walk near the ice.
sk: Pri ľade kráčajú ďalšie dva tučniaky

ref: He wants to shake hands with his colleague because a handshake needs two people.
sk: Chce podať ruku svojmu kolegovi, lebo na podanie ruky treba dvoch ľudí.

ref: She meets some happy neighbours on the way to the harbour.
sk: Cestou do prístavu stretne niekoľkých šťastných susedov.

ref: She will meet some happy neighbours on the way to the harbour.
sk: Cestou do prístavu stretne niekoľkých šťastných susedov.

ref: He fills the fridge until every shelf is full.
sk: On plní chladničku, kým nie je každá polica plná.

ref: With one strong pull on the rope, the sweep dragged the brush down the chimney.
sk: Jedným silným potiahnutím lana kominár stiahol kefu dolu komínom.

ref: Yesterday they won the final and got the trophy.
sk: Včera vyhrali finále a získali trofej.

ref: By the end of this session the artist will have blended the last stripe, or it is a disaster!
sk: Do konca tohto sedenia vizážistka roztrie posledný pruh, inak je to katastrofa!

ref: Bestie, apparently by tonight that chick will have caught a fish with its rod.
sk: Kamoška, to kuriatko vraj do večera chytí svojím prútom rybu.

ref: She was sure that nobody would ask a single question at the end.
sk: Bola si istá, že na konci nikto nepoloží ani jednu otázku.

ref: She got her flatmate to film the whole experiment from the door.
sk: Poprosila spolubývajúcu, aby celý pokus natočila od dverí.
note: Slovak says asked; 'got' implies she achieved it

ref: Parliament will have passed the new law by the end of the session, as the vote indicates.
sk: Parlament schváli nový zákon do konca zasadnutia, ako naznačuje hlasovanie.

ref: The white line is long and very straight.
sk: Biela čiara je dlhá a veľmi rovná.

ref: His white shirt has got one big collar.
sk: Jeho biela košeľa má jeden veľký golier.

ref: He usually adds a little sauce, but today he is pouring the whole bowl.
sk: Zvyčajne dá omáčky málo, ale dnes leje celú misu.

ref: He can not stop the tears tonight.
sk: Dnes večer nevie zastaviť slzy.

ref: The snake flicks its thin tongue at us.
sk: Had na nás vyplazuje svoj tenký jazyk.

ref: The hen has been defending her chicks all night, so she has been awake all night.
sk: Sliepka bránila svoje kuriatka celú noc, takže bola hore celú noc.
note: present perfect; Slovak is simple past

ref: The kindness of the stranger with the yellow umbrella made the old man smile.
sk: Láskavosť cudzieho človeka so žltým dáždnikom vyčarila starému pánovi úsmev.

ref: This car costs a lot of money.
sk: Toto auto stojí veľa peňazí

ref: She pulls her friend under the water.
sk: Ťahá svoju kamarátku pod vodu.

ref: They think the purple chemical will bubble out of the flask soon.
sk: Myslia si, že fialová chemikália čoskoro začne vybublávať z banky.

ref: He is trotting at me! Fine, I will step back.
sk: Kluše rovno na mňa! Dobre, ustúpim o krok.

ref: The teacher holds her pen, so it is in her hand.
sk: Učiteľka drží svoje pero, takže je v jej ruke.

ref: The insect is tiny, so she should study it with a lens.
sk: Ten hmyz je drobný, tak ona by mala skúmať ho lupou.

ref: They have a plan. They are going to cut the grass again tomorrow.
sk: Majú plán. Zajtra sa chystajú pokosiť trávu znova.

ref: Sunbeams fall between the tall trees.
sk: Slnečné lúče padajú medzi vysoké stromy.

ref: By the time I catch up, you will have finished the whole trail. Honestly impressive.
sk: Kým ťa dobehnem, ty budeš mať prejdený celý chodník. Úprimne pôsobivé.

ref: You must show your badge at the door.
sk: Pri dverách musíš ukázať menovku.

ref: The colorful garland fell because the tape was too weak. Total disaster!
sk: Farebná girlanda spadla, lebo lepiaca páska bola príliš slabá. Úplná katastrofa!

ref: Girl, apparently she was swirling the flask over the hotplate when her colleague came over.
sk: Zlato, vraj krúžila bankou nad varičom, keď prišiel jej kolega.

ref: In this game she hits two balls.
sk: V tomto zápase odpáli dve lopty.

ref: Ok so apparently he had mailed the postcard before his friends even woke up.
sk: Takže vraj on poslal pohľadnicu ešte predtým, než sa jeho kamaráti vôbec zobudili.

ref: You must turn off the power before you start.
sk: Pred začiatkom musíš vypnúť prúd.

ref: She used to hide her piercings from her grandma every Sunday.
sk: Každú nedeľu si schovávala piercingy pred babkou.

ref: If the tractor had a new engine, it would not make so much black smoke.
sk: Keby mal traktor nový motor, on by nevypúšťal toľko čierneho dymu.

ref: Maya counts alone, so the clipboard is in her hands.
sk: Maya počíta sama, takže podložka je v jej rukách.

ref: Look! He is running to his family right now.
sk: Pozri! Práve teraz beží k svojej rodine.

ref: If it rains harder, Tom will pull his hood up and keep going anyway.
sk: Ak bude pršať silnejšie, Tom si natiahne kapucňu a pobeží ďalej.

ref: She opened her mouth and then swept the wand along her lashes.
sk: Otvorila ústa a potom prešla aplikátorom po riasach.

ref: My school is big, old and full of students.
sk: Moja škola je veľká, stará a plná študentov.

ref: By the time he gets home, he will have looked at himself in every shop window on the way.
sk: Kým sa dostane domov, pozrie sa na seba do každej výkladnej skrine po ceste.

ref: By the time the cat jumped onto her lap, she had already closed her eyes.
sk: Kým jej mačka skočila na kolená, oči už mala zavreté

ref: Unbelievable! His rucksack is heavier than a fridge!
sk: Neuveriteľné! Jeho batoh je ťažší než chladnička!

ref: If the man hadn't shouted, the flamingos wouldn't have flown off so early.
sk: Keby muž nezakričal, plameniaky by neodleteli tak skoro.

ref: Ok so, apparently she had been testing perfumes for hours before she found that elegant one.
sk: Takže vraj testovala parfumy celé hodiny, kým našla ten elegantný.

ref: Bro, that little dog makes so much noise, no cap.
sk: Brácho, ten malý psík robí toľko hluku, bez srandy.

ref: There are four different charts on the bright screen.
sk: Na obrazovke sú štyri rôznych grafov.

ref: She can not read this confusing instruction sheet.
sk: Tento mätúci návod nevie prečítať.

ref: Bro, if fall lasted all year, I would chill in this park every day, fr.
sk: Kámo, keby jeseň trvala celý rok, v tomto parku by som chilloval každý deň, fakt.

ref: The laundromat, whose machines all run at the same slow speed, is the true home of boredom.
sk: Práčovňa, ktorej práčky idú všetky rovnako pomaly, je pravým domovom nudy.

ref: The baking sheet, which had been in that cabin for twenty years, turned everything golden.
sk: Plech, ktorý bol v tej chate dvadsať rokov, upiekol všetko dozlatista.

ref: She can practice golf all night! The man is completely shocked!
sk: Ona môže trénovať golf celú noc! Muž je úplne v šoku!

ref: The plate is hot. She says: I will take it.
sk: Tanier je horúci. Hovorí: Vezmem ho.

ref: The plate is hot. She says: I am going to take it.
sk: Tanier je horúci. Hovorí: Vezmem ho.

ref: He ties his blue gloves before the round.
sk: Pred kolom si zaväzuje svoje modré rukavice.

ref: She touches the glass. This dream is destroying her!
sk: Dotýka sa skla. Tento sen ju ničí!

ref: Report: she is famous, and 5,000 phones film her.
sk: Správa: ona je slávna a natáča ju 5 000 mobilov.

ref: The convoy was filmed from a fourth car driving just behind the last spoiler.
sk: Konvoj bol natáčaný zo štvrtého auta, ktoré išlo tesne za posledným spojlerom.

ref: She has been lifting in this competition since dawn, and the car is absolutely the final blow!
sk: Ona v tejto súťaži dvíha od úsvitu a auto je absolútne posledná rana!

ref: She is the boss, because the boss is the person in charge.
sk: Ona je šéfka, lebo šéf je ten, kto to vedie.

ref: Look! The cat is walking over the clothes pile now.
sk: Pozri! Mačka práve teraz kráča po kope oblečenia.

ref: If the woman had better equipment, she would clean the worktop much faster.
sk: Keby mala žena lepšie vybavenie, vyčistila by pracovnú dosku oveľa rýchlejšie.

ref: They wait two hours on the ridge for sunset.
sk: Na hrebeni čakajú dve hodiny na západ slnka.

ref: She jumps into a big puddle in the narrow street.
sk: Na úzkej ulici skočí do veľkej mláky

ref: Three pigeons peck near the old fountain.
sk: Pri starej fontáne zobú tri holuby

ref: The players admitted having chosen a slightly unusual court, with a mountain behind it.
sk: Hráči priznali, že si vybrali trochu nezvyčajný kurt s horou za ním.

ref: It takes them five minutes to unroll it.
sk: Rozvinúť ho im trvá päť minút.

ref: Camp rules: everyone has to awake before breakfast.
sk: Pravidlá tábora: každý sa musí zobudiť pred raňajkami.

ref: There is a lot of spaghetti in his stomach now.
sk: V jeho žalúdku je teraz veľa špagiet.

ref: You should keep a charger in your bag.
sk: Nabíjačku by si mal nosiť v taške.

ref: He used to believe that a letter was nobody else's business - then the clerk reached for her roller.
sk: Kedysi veríval, že list nikoho iného nezaujíma - a vtedy úradníčka siahla po valčeku.

ref: Come at six and their walking will be just starting.
sk: Príď o šiestej a ich prechádzka bude práve začínať.

ref: Look! He is walking up and down beside the table.
sk: Pozri! Práve teraz chodí hore-dole vedľa stola.

ref: If the camper went faster, nobody would need to pass it.
sk: Keby obytné auto išlo rýchlejšie, nikto by ho nemusel predbiehať.

ref: If he keeps his back straight from now on, the pain will disappear in a few weeks.
sk: Ak si odteraz drží chrbát rovno, bolesť zmizne za pár týždňov.

ref: He is the first one smiling in the office even though he spends two hours a day on a tram.
sk: V kancelárii sa usmieva ako prvý, hoci strávi dve hodiny denne v električke.

ref: The student sits at a desk full of books.
sk: Študentka sedí za stolom plným kníh.

ref: Only one pill stays in the empty bowl.
sk: V prázdnej miske zostáva len jedna tabletka.

ref: If you feel this sad, you should call a good friend.
sk: Ak si takto smutný, mal by si zavolať kamarátke.

ref: Listen, she told me her fitness routine had started at 5 a.m. the day before.
sk: Počúvaj, povedala mi, že jej kondičný režim začal deň predtým o piatej ráno.

ref: She tasted the first piece and closed her eyes.
sk: Ochutnala prvý kúsok a zavrela oči.

ref: She wants to get the old wardrobe painted white before the summer.
sk: Chce si dať starú skriňu natrieť nabielo pred letom.

ref: He was kneeling on the grass, screaming, when his teammate crashed into him!
sk: On kľačal na tráve a kričal, keď do neho narazil spoluhráč!

ref: The man has got a football and a varsity jacket.
sk: Muž má loptu na americký futbal a univerzitnú bundu.

ref: Can hot water melt ice in one minute?
sk: Dokáže horúca voda roztopiť ľad za minútu?

ref: The knife is sharp. Can he cut the onion fast?
sk: Nôž je ostrý. Môže on nakrájať cibuľu rýchlo?

ref: The stack, whose top pallet fell first, crashed onto the lawn.
sk: Stoh, ktorého vrchná paleta spadla prvá, sa zrútil na trávnik.

ref: She has thrown one cushion onto the floor beside the rug, and the other is still in the air.
sk: Ona hodila jeden vankúš na zem vedľa koberca a druhý je ešte vo vzduchu.

ref: In spite of the warning signs at the camp, she walked right out to the edge.
sk: Napriek výstražným tabuliam v kempe došla až na okraj.

ref: He steps from block to block over the green water.
sk: On prestupuje z bloku na blok nad zelenou vodou.

ref: A plaza is a place where there is a lot of space, so this plaza is spacious.
sk: Námestie je miesto, kde je veľa priestoru, takže toto námestie je priestranné.

ref: Both halves are ready, so clearly they are going to agree on the deal.
sk: Obe polovice sú pripravené, tak sa jasne chystajú zhodnúť na dohode.

ref: This phone is ringing again!
sk: Tento telefón zase zvoní!

ref: There are two bowls of cereal on the table.
sk: Na stole sú dve misky cereálií.

ref: You smile so happily on a fast bike. Iconic.
sk: Ty sa usmievaš tak šťastne na rýchlom bicykli. Ikonické.

ref: You are smiling so happily on a fast bike. Iconic.
sk: Ty sa usmievaš tak šťastne na rýchlom bicykli. Ikonické.

ref: This squad has been training together as teammates for 6 months, and the target is the final.
sk: Tento tím trénuje spolu ako spoluhráči už 6 mesiacov a cieľom je finále.

ref: The matches lie in a small wooden box.
sk: Zápalky ležia v malej drevenej škatuľke.

ref: By the end of the ride, the tram's arm will have thrown hundreds of sparks from the wire.
sk: Do konca jazdy vykreše zberač električky z drôtu stovky iskier.
note: zberač is the tram's pantograph/current collector, 'arm' is vague

ref: How do you cook like that? Rich kitchen, smooth moves.
sk: Ako to takto varíš? Bohatá kuchyňa, elegantné pohyby.

ref: It's 10:50 already. Honestly, you are going to be late, but with confidence.
sk: Už je 10:50. Úprimne, ty budeš neskoro, ale sebavedome.

ref: If you aim for too long, your arm starts to shake and the arrow drops.
sk: Keď mieriš príliš dlho, ruka sa ti začne triasť a šíp klesne.

ref: You are freezing. You must take off those wet boots.
sk: Si premrznutá. Musíš si zobuť tie mokré čižmy.

ref: Honestly, you packed that full fridge so neatly Impressive.
sk: Úprimne, tú plnú chladničku si zaplnil tak úhľadne Pôsobivé.

ref: Dude, she has been scanning the shore for ten minutes, what's she even lookin' for?
sk: Kámo, ona skúma breh už desať minút, čo tam vôbec hľadá?

ref: If a cable car rises to a great height, the air gets colder.
sk: Keď lanovka vystúpi do veľkej výšky, vzduch je chladnejší.

ref: Which subject do you like? Music or chemistry?
sk: Ktorý predmet máš rád? Hudbu, alebo chémiu?

ref: Bestie, she said many neighbours walked behind the elderly lady.
sk: Zlatko, vravela, že za tou staršou paňou kráčalo veľa susedov.

ref: By sunset, the crane boom will have spanned the entire site, casting a terrifying shadow!
sk: Do západu slnka výložník žeriavu preklenie celé stavenisko a vrhne desivý tieň!

ref: There is a fence between you and the drop, smart choice, honestly.
sk: Medzi tebou a zrázom je plot, múdra voľba, fakt.

ref: Your product rows are perfect. Honestly, you should run this shop.
sk: Tvoje rady výrobkov sú dokonalé. Úprimne, ty by si mal viesť tento obchod.

ref: He loves surfing in big waves.
sk: On miluje surfovanie vo veľkých vlnách.

ref: Disaster is coming and he is going to bike home on that old bike!
sk: Blíži sa katastrofa a on sa chystá bicyklovať domov na tom starom bicykli!

ref: This is the only apple on the blanket.
sk: Toto je to jediné jablko na deke.

ref: If a trip is worldwide, a traveller usually needs clothes for heat and for snow.
sk: Keď je cesta celosvetová, cestovateľ zvyčajne potrebuje oblečenie do horúčavy aj do snehu.

ref: Her tears flooded the floor around her knees.
sk: Jej slzy zaplavili podlahu okolo jej kolien.

ref: He has eaten nothing since he saw the crack.
sk: Odkedy uvidel prasklinu, nezjedol nič.

ref: Buying this dress is more expensive than the whole trip! Ruined!
sk: Kúpiť túto róbu je drahšie ako celý výlet! Zničené!

ref: She wipes its big green leaves with a cloth.
sk: Handričkou utrie jej veľké zelené listy.

ref: She will wipe its big green leaves with a cloth.
sk: Handričkou utrie jej veľké zelené listy.

ref: She puts a hot bowl in front of the happy man.
sk: Postaví pred neho horúcu misku

ref: She washes the giant carrot with a watering can.
sk: Umyje tú obrovskú mrkvu krhlou.

ref: She will wash the giant carrot with a watering can.
sk: Umyje tú obrovskú mrkvu krhlou.

ref: Status update: the stone figure was standing on the beach at 6:40 when it collapsed.
sk: Aktualizácia stavu: kamenná postava stála o 6:40 na pláži, keď sa zrútila.

ref: Look! He is running down the platform right now.
sk: Pozri! Práve teraz beží po nástupišti.

ref: Look! She is running down the platform right now.
sk: Pozri! Práve teraz beží po nástupišti.

ref: The coin heap is an asset worth 50 euros.
sk: Kopa mincí je aktívum v hodnote 50 eur.

ref: Girl, apparently that win was huge, wasn't it?
sk: Zlatko, vraj to víťazstvo bolo obrovské, nebolo?

ref: Her hand is on her heart! The worst day ever!
sk: Jej ruka je na jej srdci! Najhorší deň vôbec!

ref: There are hats for tourists, because tourists have got heads.
sk: Sú klobúky pre turistov, lebo turisti majú hlavy.

ref: Not gonna lie, you are a true football fan.
sk: Nebudem klamať, ty si skutočný futbalový fanúšik.

ref: Wait, you used to hate heights, and now you ride over pines like a pro? Respect.
sk: Počkaj, ty si zvykol nenávidieť výšky a teraz sa vezieš nad borovicami ako profík? Rešpekt.

ref: Don't call me at three — I will be standing in the queue for that hat stand.
sk: Nevolaj mi o tretej — vtedy budem stáť v rade pri stánku s klobúkmi.
span: in the queue for that hat stand
note: 'hat stand' means coat rack; stánok is a hat stall

ref: By the end of this year, the young man will have piloted planes for 500 hours.
sk: Do konca tohto roka mladý muž odpilotuje lietadlá 500 hodín.

ref: You must blow on hot soup before you eat it.
sk: Na horúcu polievku musíš fúkať, kým ju zješ.

ref: Her scarf is loud, and so are her boots.
sk: Jej šál je výrazný a jej čižmy tiež

ref: She shears the sheep every spring.
sk: Ovcu strihá každú jar.

ref: Every summer, the little boats ferry tourists across the harbour.
sk: Každé leto malé lode prevážajú turistov cez prístav.

ref: While the butcher was weighing the steak, the customer waited at the counter.
sk: Kým mäsiar vážil steak, zákazník čakal pri pulte.

ref: While the butcher was weighing the steak, the customer was waiting at the counter.
sk: Kým mäsiar vážil steak, zákazník čakal pri pulte.

ref: Can she read her book at the bus stop? Yes, she can.
sk: Môže ona čítať svoju knihu na zastávke? Áno, môže.

ref: The young man warms his pyjamas on the radiator.
sk: Mladý muž si zohrieva svoje pyžamo na radiátore.

ref: The young man is warming his pyjamas on the radiator.
sk: Mladý muž si zohrieva svoje pyžamo na radiátore.

ref: The swan swims on the calm grey lake.
sk: Labuť pláva po pokojnom sivom jazere.

ref: The swan is swimming on the calm grey lake.
sk: Labuť pláva po pokojnom sivom jazere.

ref: If this place is free, I will sit here too.
sk: Ak je toto miesto voľné, sadnem si sem tiež.

ref: The old seaman who is struggling with the wheel has sailed through many storms.
sk: Starý námorník, ktorý zápasí s kormidlom, už preplával mnoho búrok.

ref: The tomato slices lie on the wooden board.
sk: Kolieska paradajky ležia na drevenej doske.

ref: Ok so, apparently she was folding the filling into the dough when the boy grabbed a spoon.
sk: Takže, ona vraj zabaľovala plnku do cesta, keď chlapec schmatol lyžicu.
span: folding the filling into the dough
note: 'fold into' means mix in; Slovak means wrapping filling in dough

ref: Misty hills used to be her worst nightmare, but now she walks through them in the rain!
sk: Hmlisté kopce bývali jej najhoršou nočnou morou, ale teraz nimi kráča v daždi!

ref: Two people share one red umbrella now.
sk: Dvaja ľudia teraz zdieľajú jeden červený dáždnik.

ref: Two people are sharing one red umbrella now.
sk: Dvaja ľudia teraz zdieľajú jeden červený dáždnik.

ref: He draws five green arms on the cactus.
sk: Kaktusu nakreslí päť zelených ramien.

ref: He will draw five green arms on the cactus.
sk: Kaktusu nakreslí päť zelených ramien.

ref: A woman hangs a gold medal around his neck.
sk: Žena mu na krk zavesí jednu zlatú medailu.

ref: A woman will hang a gold medal around his neck.
sk: Žena mu na krk zavesí jednu zlatú medailu.

ref: The street was bright despite the late hour, thanks to the neon signs.
sk: Ulica bola jasná napriek neskorej hodine, vďaka neónovým nápisom.

ref: Yesterday the artist drew the whole tattoo.
sk: Včera tatér nakreslil celé tetovanie.

ref: Soon this insect will become a butterfly.

sk: Skupina sa pozerá hore na túto vysokú drevenú konštrukciu.

ref: There is a lot of popcorn in her tub, so she is happy.
sk: V jej vaničke je veľa popcornu, takže je šťastná.

sk: Nie je tu žiadna sieť, takže je to volejbal bez siete.

ref: The helmet is on her head all the time.
sk: Prilbu má na hlave celý čas.

ref: Can you plant a row this straight?
sk: Dokážeš zasadiť taký rovný rad?

ref: The textbook lies open on the small desk.
sk: Učebnica leží otvorená na malom stole.

ref: The bills slide out of the open wallet onto the counter.
sk: Bankovky vykĺzavajú z otvorenej peňaženky na pult.

ref: She was afraid, but she did not lose hope.

ref: There is one big cake on the tray.

sk: Hokej je rýchla hra na studenom ľade.

sk: Veľvyslanectvo, ktorého vlajka visí nad vchodom, ešte aj za súmraku prijíma dokumenty.

sk: Ty zvyčajne kladieš jeden tanier, ale včera si pripravil hostinu. Elegantné!

sk: Táto voda bola zničená jediným človekom asi za desať sekúnd.

ref: Can you feel how hot it is today?
sk: Môžeš cítiť, aké je dnes horúco?

ref: The eagle had fished in this bay for years before anyone filmed it.
sk: Orol lovil ryby v tejto zátoke roky, kým ho niekto natočil.

sk: Každé pondelkové ráno jej niekto nechá kávu.

sk: V miske sú len dve hračky a už je to vojna!

sk: On dvíha svoj cylinder. Je zdvorilejší než ostatní muži v parku.

sk: Tom netušil, že sa jeho ľahký ranný beh zmení na každodenný zvyk.

sk: Chlapec na šmykľavke má na sebe farebné šortky.

sk: Remeselník brúsil strechu približne desať minút, kým bol povrch hladký.

ref: A few grains have landed already in the bottom of the bowl.
sk: Niekoľko zrniek už pristálo na dne misky.

ref: The staff have printed over 500 name badges at registration so far.
sk: Personál na registrácii zatiaľ vytlačil vyše 500 menoviek.

ref: If a minister raises a hand, the vote counts as a yes.
sk: Ak minister zdvihne ruku, hlas sa počíta ako áno.

sk: Strieľala zo svojej pušky naživo v televízii, mierne súkromná chvíľa.

sk: Štít je hore, lebo je vysoko, a je aj vrtuľník.

sk: Neuveriteľné! Nie je veľa darčekov veľkých ako babka!

sk: Zlatko, počula som, že pes vylezie späť hore po každom páde.

sk: Kamoška, počula som, že opravuje takéto maličké kolieska už desať rokov.

sk: Dôstojník otvára tento kufor na stole.

sk: Ženích stál pred zrkadlom celú hodinu pred svadbou! Nočná mora!

sk: Objaviteľ sa presekával cez liany, keď mu nad hlavou preletel ara.

sk: Bicykle sú na tejto trati rýchle.

sk: Kde letí lietadlo? Nad mestom.

sk: Na doske sú dve polovice sendviča.

sk: Muž vedel, že potlesk bude dlhý, ako to typicky nastáva po silnom výkone.

sk: Ak bude udržiavať oheň celú noc, bude ešte viac popola. Nádhera.

sk: Môžem ti ponúknuť tortu? Je to torta, takže áno.

sk: Popraskaná zem na úpätí sopky je pokrytá žiariacou lávou.

ref: Yesterday the cab was steered with one hand through rush hour. Clearly the safest ride in town.
sk: Včera taxík bol riadený jednou rukou cez dopravnú špičku. Zjavne najbezpečnejšia jazda v meste.

sk: Kámo, do poludnia ten úradník povolí vstup do krajiny tak 200 ľuďom, fakt.

sk: Električka išla dolu po koľaji, keď mladá žena zoskočila z jej schodíka.

ref: What does she tie? A bunch of green herbs.
sk: Čo zväzuje? Zväzok zelených byliniek.

sk: Čo zväzuje? Zväzok zelených byliniek.

sk: Momentálne sa ona pozerá hore na obrovský mozog na výstave.

ref: In summer, two children run through the sprinkler.
sk: V lete dve deti bežia cez postrekovač.

ref: Try one peach and you will buy the whole box.
sk: Skús jednu broskyňu a kúpiš celú debničku.

ref: Yesterday she put the same cream on her face.
sk: Včera si na tvár dala ten istý krém.

sk: Študent išiel ďalej, ale vedec sa zastavil pri každom grafe.

ref: Great choice, obviously. Every day he wears a fur hat in the sauna.
sk: Skvelá voľba, samozrejme. Každý deň on nosí v saune kožušinovú čiapku.

ref: She has been training for this height since the first round.
sk: Na túto výšku trénuje od prvého kola.

ref: Her foot is red, and so is her ankle.
sk: Noha je červená a členok tiež

ref: Not greedy, of course: he made just twenty slices of toast.
sk: Vôbec nie nenásytný, samozrejme: on urobil len dvadsať hrianok.

ref: Where do the divers swim? Up to the sunny surface.
sk: Kam plávajú potápači? Hore k slnečnej hladine.

sk: Do poludnia subjekt bude zdvíhať ťažkú batožinu približne hodinu.

ref: The boy wishes the doctor had examined him before lunch; now he is hungry.
sk: Chlapec by si želal, aby ho lekárka bola vyšetrila pred obedom; teraz je hladný.

ref: Their new house has two floors and one green door.
sk: Ich nový dom má dve poschodia a jedny zelené dvere.

ref: Your wrist hurts? OK, I will get you a bandage!
sk: Bolí ťa zápästie? Dobre, prinesiem ti obväz.

sk: Keď si dohodla návštevu, netušila, že strávia pol rána na tých stoličkách.

sk: Keby bola taška zatvorená, počas zatýkania by nevypadla žiadna korisť.

sk: Do konca polroka bude mať nazbieranú zlatú hviezdu ako odmenu na každej strane.

sk: Pod košeľou má biele tričko.

sk: Želá si, aby opuch spľasol pred zápasom.

ref: Two people dance in the narrow lane.
sk: Dvaja ľudia tancujú v úzkej uličke.

ref: Clearly a relaxing job: if she answers the phone, more paperwork lands on her desk.
sk: Jasné, oddychová práca: keď ona zdvihne telefón, na stôl jej pristane ďalšia administratíva.

ref: Look, the host is asking a very easy question right now.
sk: Pozri, moderátor sa práve pýta veľmi ľahkú otázku.

ref: The paramedics walked quickly to the door with the bag.
sk: Záchranári kráčali s taškou rýchlo k dverám.

ref: The drummers had been playing for ten minutes when he finally raised the flag, a very quiet ceremony.
sk: Bubeníci už desať minút hrali, keď konečne vytiahol vlajku, veľmi tichý ceremoniál.

ref: She points at the keys, so the search is going to end in a second.
sk: Ona ukazuje na kľúče, takže hľadanie skončí o sekundu.

ref: The man fills his side of the fridge.
sk: Muž si napĺňa svoju stranu chladničky.

ref: The man is filling his side of the fridge.
sk: Muž si napĺňa svoju stranu chladničky.

ref: They have been pushing through deep snow since sunrise, so their legs must be on fire by now.
sk: Od svitania sa predierajú hlbokým snehom, takže ich nohy musia byť už v jednom ohni.

ref: Honestly, by the end of the day you will have made a thousand bubbles in that tank.
sk: Úprimne, do konca dňa urobíš v tej nádrži tisíc bublín.

ref: She melts ice now, but before she melted snow.
sk: Teraz roztápa ľad, ale predtým roztápala sneh.

ref: Yesterday she ran on the same wall.
sk: Včera bežala po tom istom múre.

ref: Bro, he gotta get permission before the end of the day.
sk: Kámo, on musí získať povolenie do konca dňa.

ref: What is the budget? Two drops of serum on the cheeks.
sk: Čo je rozpočet? Dve kvapky séra na lícach.

ref: The boy will never forget this burger!
sk: Chlapec nikdy nezabudne na tento burger!

ref: One balloon has one basket, so ten balloons have ten baskets.
sk: Jeden balón má jeden kôš, takže desať balónov má desať košov.

ref: You had been wiping that filthy mirror for ten minutes before it finally shone. Respect.
sk: Ty si utieral to zasvinené zrkadlo desať minút, kým sa konečne zaligotalo. Rešpekt.

ref: They play football on a stone plaza.
sk: Futbal hrajú na kamennom námestí.

ref: They are playing football on a stone plaza.
sk: Futbal hrajú na kamennom námestí.

ref: It is very windy, but she can stand on the seafront.
sk: Je veľmi veterno, ale ona môže stáť na nábreží.

ref: By the end of the day, the engineer will have checked every gauge on this old machinery.
sk: Do konca dňa inžinier skontroluje každý manometer na týchto starých strojoch.

ref: The camera was zooming in on the spines while she pointed at the tall cactus.
sk: Kamera približovala na tŕne, kým ukazovala na vysoký kaktus.

ref: The seats are dark. Can you see the screen?
sk: Sedadlá sú v tme. Môžeš vidieť plátno?
note: Slovak means the seats are in the dark

ref: They usually walk here, but today they played in the stream.
sk: Zvyčajne sa tu prechádzajú, ale dnes sa v potoku hrali

ref: If he believed her predictions, he wouldn't be standing in the rain in a T-shirt.
sk: Keby veril jej predpovediam, nestál by teraz v daždi v tričku.

ref: The dogs work in the warehouse because the pallets are there, don't they?
sk: Psy pracujú v sklade, lebo sú tam palety, však?

ref: How many flags are on the committee's table?
sk: Koľko vlajok je na stole výboru?

ref: The hen pressed the stick across the pigeon's beak.
sk: Sliepka pritlačila palicu holubovi na zobák.

ref: Remarkably, pedestrians have been streaming across the junction in all directions since the light changed.
sk: Pozoruhodné je, že chodci prúdia cez križovatku vo všetkých smeroch, odkedy sa zmenilo svetlo.

ref: The string is ready. They are going to lay the next row now.
sk: Šnúra je pripravená. Chystajú sa položiť ďalší rad.

ref: The room is dark, so they can see every star.
sk: V sále je tma, takže vidia každú hviezdu.

ref: The barber has been trimming that huge beard for ten minutes and the floor is already covered in hair.
sk: Holič strihá tú obrovskú bradu už desať minút a podlaha je celá od chlpov.

ref: The stones are wet, so you must walk slowly.
sk: Kamene sú mokré, takže musíš kráčať pomaly.

ref: She said he could enter the country.
sk: Povedala, že do krajiny môže vstúpiť

ref: If you measure a tall child, the child is tall, because tall children are tall.
sk: Keď zmeriaš vysoké dieťa, to dieťa je vysoké, lebo vysoké deti sú vysoké.

ref: There is not much water in this dry earth.
sk: V tejto suchej zemine nie je veľa vody.

ref: Target: 200 words. Usually he forgets, but yesterday he remembered them all.
sk: Cieľ: 200 slov. On zvyčajne zabúda, ale včera si ich zapamätal všetky.

ref: You love these steep steps, and honestly, so do I.
sk: Miluješ tieto strmé schody a úprimne, ja tiež.

ref: A silver car costs 20,000 euros. The cost is high.
sk: Strieborné auto stojí 20 000 eur. Cena je vysoká.

ref: The parents are totally exhausted, but the kids want the swings again!
sk: Rodičia sú úplne vyčerpaní, ale deti chcú znova na hojdačky!

ref: This wind is stronger than yesterday.
sk: Tento vietor je silnejší než včera.

ref: She said she had written her signature herself because it was her own name.
sk: Povedala, že napísala svoj podpis sama, lebo to bolo jej vlastné meno.

ref: 2 people play volleyball in the street.
sk: 2 ľudia hrajú volejbal na ulici.

ref: She draws a big sun on the paper.
sk: Na papier kreslí veľké slnko.

ref: How does she pay? — With a bank card.
sk: Čím platí? — Bankovou kartou.

ref: What does she pay with? — With a bank card.
sk: Čím platí? — Bankovou kartou.

ref: Park rule, clearly a fun one: visitors have to stay off the statue.
sk: Pravidlo parku, zjavne veľmi zábavné: návštevníci musia zostať ďalej od sochy.
note: Slovak means keep away from, not stay off

ref: The terminal, whose windows face the runway, was silent.
sk: Terminál, ktorého okná smerujú na dráhu, bol tichý.

ref: Runner 299 is winning a medal right now, on target.
sk: Bežec 299 práve teraz vyhráva medailu, podľa plánu.

ref: They have a plan. They are going to sell fresh pies for the whole village.
sk: Oni majú plán. Oni sa chystajú predať čerstvé koláče celej dedine.
note: sell to the village, not for it

ref: Two friends lie on the dinghy and have fun.
sk: Dvaja kamaráti ležia na člne a zabávajú sa.

ref: Leading strangers through a night forest is an unusual summer job.
sk: Viesť cudzích ľudí nočným lesom je nezvyčajná letná brigáda.

ref: Look at its legs! The giraffe is going to bend down now.
sk: Pozri na tie nohy! Žirafa sa o chvíľu zohne

ref: It is very hot. You must drink water every hour!
sk: Je veľmi horúco. Musíš piť vodu každú hodinu!

ref: Juggling needs talent and a lot of patience every day.
sk: Žonglovanie potrebuje talent a veľa trpezlivosti každý deň.

ref: That little wrapped present wasn't opened by anyone at all this evening.
sk: Ten malý zabalený darček dnes večer nebol otvorený vôbec nikým.

ref: If she hadn't raised her paddle, she would be looking at an empty wall right now.
sk: Keby nebola zdvihla tabuľku, teraz by pozerala na prázdnu stenu.

ref: The wall used to stretch much further before parts of it fell down.
sk: Múr sa zvykol tiahnuť oveľa ďalej, predtým než sa jeho časti zrútili.

ref: The vaccine is said to have been tested on thousands of volunteers last year.
sk: Vakcína vraj bola testovaná na tisícoch dobrovoľníkov minulý rok.

ref: Honestly, by midnight you will have made her calm again; you're kind of amazing at this.
sk: Úprimne, do polnoci ju zase upokojíš; v tomto si fakt úžasný.
note: fakt means really, not kind of

ref: She has done five yoga poses since the sun started to set.
sk: Odkedy slnko začalo zapadať, ona urobila päť jogových pozícií.

ref: Before the budget increase, the daycare had been looking after 20 toddlers in one room for years.
sk: Pred navýšením rozpočtu sa jasle roky starali o 20 batoliat v jednej miestnosti.

ref: This sailor is calmer than the sea today.
sk: Táto námorníčka je dnes pokojnejšia ako more.

ref: This time next year she will be wearing six rings in that ear.
sk: O rok o takomto čase bude nosiť v tom uchu šesť krúžkov.

ref: They have got a 9 AM meeting, so she adjusts his tie.
sk: Oni majú stretnutie o 9:00, tak mu upravuje kravatu.

ref: They have a 9 AM meeting, so she adjusts his tie.
sk: Oni majú stretnutie o 9:00, tak mu upravuje kravatu.

ref: Look! She is winding the pasta onto the fork.
sk: Pozri! Práve namotáva cestoviny na vidličku.

ref: If the little animal hadn't fallen, it wouldn't have landed on the giant's head.
sk: Keby malé zvieratko nespadlo, nepristálo by na hlave obra.

ref: He wishes the crew would continue their praise forever! Never again silence!
sk: Želá si, aby štáb pokračoval vo svojich pochvalách navždy! Už nikdy ticho!

ref: The ship on her vacation has two funnels.
sk: Loď na jej dovolenke má dva komíny.

ref: At nine tomorrow morning the director will be shooting the pirate scene all over again.
sk: Zajtra o deviatej ráno režisérka bude natáčať pirátsku scénu úplne odznova.

ref: She had checked the compass only once before she sailed out. Flawless planning.
sk: Kompas skontrolovala iba raz, kým vyplávala. Dokonalé plánovanie.

ref: You should not shake the bottle so hard.
sk: Fľaštičkou by si nemal tak silno triasť.

ref: At nine tomorrow, she will be studying at her new workspace.
sk: Zajtra o deviatej ona bude študovať na svojom novom pracovnom mieste.

ref: A dam is an old wall that holds water back.
sk: Priehrada je starý múr, ktorý zadržiava vodu.

ref: Bro, look at that powerful spray. He is going to get soaked, no cap.
sk: Brácho, pozri na tú silnú spŕšku. On premokne, bez srandy.
note: spŕška is a rain shower; silná means heavy

ref: The boy was happy in the barn, and so was the horse with its carrot.
sk: Chlapec bol v stodole šťastný a bol aj kôň so svojou mrkvou.

ref: That jumper is smaller than a cushion now, so it can't fit her again.
sk: Ten sveter je teraz menší ako vankúš, takže jej už nemôže sedieť.

ref: Girl, she gave him a kiss, but he kept scowling, apparently.
sk: Počuj, dala mu bozk, ale on sa vraj stále mračil.

ref: She puts a flat stone on the top.
sk: Ona kladie plochý kameň na vrchol.

ref: He asked us to keep the desk still while he focused the lens.
sk: Poprosil nás, aby sme nehýbali lavicou, kým zaostruje šošovku.

ref: He shakes the ketchup bottle over his fries.
sk: Trasie fľašou kečupu nad hranolkami.

ref: He is shaking the ketchup bottle over his fries.
sk: Trasie fľašou kečupu nad hranolkami.

ref: You must smile back when somebody smiles at you.
sk: Keď sa na teba niekto usmeje, musíš sa usmiať späť.

ref: He looks at her outfit proudly and claps.
sk: Na jej outfit sa pozerá hrdo a tlieska.

ref: This jacket is warmer than his thin grey sweater.
sk: Táto bunda je teplejšia ako jeho tenký sivý sveter.

ref: That pink powder is meant to be swept onto the cheeks with a big soft brush, not with your fingers.
sk: Ten ružový púder sa má nanášať veľkým mäkkým štetcom na líca, nie prstami.

ref: The mother has got three hungry children and one pancake! Disaster!
sk: Matka má tri hladné deti a jednu palacinku! Katastrofa!

ref: You should ride that bicycle at sunset more often. Smooth.
sk: Štýlové: mal by si jazdiť na tom bicykli pri západe slnka častejšie.

ref: The chef was exhausted, and so were the waiters.
sk: Šéfkuchár bol vyčerpaný a čašníci tiež

ref: One shirt button is missing, so she has to stitch it back on.
sk: Na košeli chýba jeden gombík, tak ho musí prišiť späť.

ref: The fruit basket is already high up on the rope.
sk: Košík s ovocím je už vysoko hore na lane.

ref: Yesterday they kinda discussed it for two hours, no cap.
sk: Včera to tak dve hodiny prediskutovali, fakt.
span: kinda discussed it for two hours
note: tak = about two hours; hedge moved onto verb

ref: Their faces in the phone are very funny.
sk: Ich tváre v telefóne sú veľmi vtipné.

ref: Look at the sky! The sun is going to come up soon.
sk: Pozri na nebo! Slnko čoskoro vyjde

ref: Look at the sky! The sun will come up soon.
sk: Pozri na nebo! Slnko čoskoro vyjde

ref: Nah man, if nobody takes the box, it will stay there all week, fr.
sk: Nie, kámo, ak tú krabicu nikto nevezme, zostane tam celý týždeň, fakt.

ref: By summer, you will have put this fracture behind you, and honestly, respect.
sk: Do leta ty budeš mať túto zlomeninu za sebou, a úprimne, rešpekt.

ref: The crew clapped because they had just finished the hardest scene of the production.
sk: Štáb tlieskal, lebo práve dokončil najťažšiu scénu inscenácie.

ref: When did you arrive? At three o'clock.
sk: Kedy si prišiel? O tretej.

ref: Why does she check the board? Because the board is there.
sk: Prečo kontroluje tabuľu? Lebo tabuľa je tam.

ref: He stands with bare feet on the warm sand.
sk: Stojí bosý na teplom piesku.

ref: What do they look at? At the rocky peaks.
sk: Na čo sa pozerajú? Na skalnaté štíty.

ref: What are they looking at? At the rocky peaks.
sk: Na čo sa pozerajú? Na skalnaté štíty.

ref: Look! He is hopping through the ladder now.
sk: Pozri! Práve teraz skáče cez rebrík.

ref: This kick sends the leaves up into the air.
sk: Toto kopnutie vyhadzuje lístie do vzduchu.

ref: The chair tower is swaying, so it must be very risky to climb.
sk: Veža zo stoličiek sa kýve, takže liezť na ňu musí byť veľmi riskantné.

ref: If the wind blows hard, the sand on the dune moves.
sk: Keď vietor fúka silno, piesok na dune sa hýbe.

ref: If the thread were thicker, the seam would look clumsy.
sk: Keby niť bola hrubšia, šev by vyzeral neohrabane.

ref: Bro, the rocket towers over him, so big, gotta jump.
sk: Brácho, raketa sa nad ním týči, je taká obrovská, treba skákať.

ref: She has got one direction and a brass compass.
sk: Ona má jeden smer a mosadzný kompas.

ref: When does the adult sign 20 forms? Before the deadline.
sk: Kedy ten dospelý podpisuje 20 formulárov? Pred termínom.

ref: Yesterday she typed the same essay in ten minutes.
sk: Včera napísala tú istú esej za desať minút.

ref: If you drop the ball up here, it rolls straight off the roof.
sk: Ak tu hore pustíš loptu, skotúľa sa rovno zo strechy.

ref: Smooth: you have been tearing paper apart for five minutes and you're still so calm.
sk: Elegantné: už päť minút trháš papier a stále si taká pokojná.

ref: She puts on an old gold chain.
sk: Nasadí si starú zlatú retiazku.

ref: The clerk had been counting notes for an hour before she walked into the lobby.
sk: Úradník počítal bankovky hodinu, kým vošla do haly.

ref: If the wind stays strong, his nephew's kite will fly even higher.
sk: Ak vietor zostane silný, šarkan jeho synovca poletí ešte vyššie.

ref: If two people compete at arm wrestling, both elbows stay on the pads.
sk: Keď dvaja ľudia súťažia v pretláčaní rukou, oba lakte zostávajú na podložkách.

ref: There are three shampoo bottles behind the puppy.
sk: Za šteniatkom stoja tri fľaše šampónu.

ref: Where is the modern tower? Next to the old brick block.
sk: Kde je moderná veža? Vedľa starého tehlového domu.

ref: The filming of the crying scene has been going on for three hours now.
sk: Natáčanie scény s plačom prebieha už tri hodiny.

ref: She unlocked the black door, and then she picked through the ring of keys.
sk: Ona odomkla čierne dvere a potom sa prehrabávala zväzkom kľúčov.

ref: If the neon signs were any brighter, she would need sunglasses at midnight. Flawless lighting.
sk: Keby boli neónové nápisy ešte jasnejšie, potrebovala by o polnoci slnečné okuliare. Dokonalé osvetlenie.

ref: You two are in the same dress, and honestly, iconic.
sk: Vy dve ste v rovnakých šatách, a úprimne, ikonické.

ref: No way, I heard by the end of summer he will have scored fifty goals in that park.
sk: Nemožné, vraj do konca leta dá v tom parku päťdesiat gólov.

ref: Both arms are shaking and neither one is moving - this must be a draw.
sk: Obe ruky sa trasú a ani jedna sa nehýbe - toto musí byť remíza.

ref: The eraser is tiny, it is going to break very soon.
sk: Guma je maličká, čoskoro sa ide rozpadnúť.

ref: The mud is deep, so you must pull together.
sk: Blato je hlboké, takže musíte ťahať spolu.

ref: Look at that chrysalis — it is going to open soon.
sk: Pozri na tú kuklu – čoskoro sa otvorí

ref: Bestie, she said she usually celebrates inside. Tonight she is celebrating outside.
sk: Zlatko, vraj zvyčajne oslavuje vnútri. Dnes večer oslavuje vonku.

ref: By the end of the day, the parade will have completed its entire route, as it typically does.
sk: Do konca dňa sprievod prejde celú svoju trasu, ako to zvyčajne robí.

ref: He uses three brushes for her whole face.
sk: Na celú tvár použije tri štetce.

ref: He uses three brushes for the whole face.
sk: Na celú tvár použije tri štetce.

ref: The workers should have rebelled much earlier; the rules had been unfair for years.
sk: Zamestnanci sa mali vzbúriť oveľa skôr; pravidlá boli roky nespravodlivé.

ref: The mother has got scissors and a comb in her hand.
sk: Mama má nožnice a hrebeň v ruke.

ref: The dashboard is between the handlebars.
sk: Prístrojovka je medzi riadidlami.

ref: Her journal looks so calm. I think I will start one too.
sk: Jej zápisník vyzerá tak pokojne. Myslím, že si založím tiež jeden.

ref: He shouldn't have left his power bank at home - one percent is nobody's idea of a relaxing coffee.
sk: Nemal nechať powerbanku doma - jedno percento nie je nikoho predstava o pokojnej kávičke.

ref: The daughter bakes in the kitchen and the flour is a disaster!
sk: Dcéra pečie v kuchyni a tá múka je katastrofa!

ref: Not gonna lie, you can build a shelf. My doubt is gone.
sk: Úprimne, ty vieš postaviť policu. Moja pochybnosť je preč.

ref: The plate is not clean, so the kitten is washing it now.
sk: Tanier nie je čistý, tak ho mačiatko teraz umýva.

ref: Bestie, apparently he had his friend run up with the net, and the disappointment was real.
sk: Kamoška, vraj nechal kamaráta pribehnúť so sieťkou, a sklamanie bolo skutočné.

ref: The two red cargo ships brought their goods into the port by sea.
sk: Dve červené nákladné lode priviezli svoj tovar do prístavu po mori.

ref: Where does she dunk the cookie? — In her hot drink.
sk: Kam si namáča sušienku? — Do horúceho nápoja.

ref: The nurse winds tape around his hand.
sk: Sestrička omotáva pásku okolo ruky.

ref: This race is faster than the one last week.
sk: Tieto preteky sú rýchlejšie než tie minulý týždeň.

ref: Why does she not answer? This cafe is a nightmare!
sk: Prečo neodpovedá? Táto kaviareň je nočná mora!

ref: She jumps over the bar on her first try.
sk: Latku preskočí na prvý pokus.

ref: She will jump over the bar on her first try.
sk: Latku preskočí na prvý pokus.

ref: She wears blue with white trousers every time.
sk: Ona nosí modrú s bielymi nohavicami zakaždým.

ref: Charming: you are putting the cover over the chairs right now.
sk: Očarujúce: práve teraz dávaš plachtu cez stoličky.

ref: She hits him with her big white pillow.
sk: Udrie ho svojím veľkým bielym vankúšom.

ref: She will hit him with her big white pillow.
sk: Udrie ho svojím veľkým bielym vankúšom.

ref: Even though they had never built anything before, their cardboard chair held a heavy stone.
sk: Hoci predtým nikdy nič nepostavili, ich kartónová stolička udržala ťažký kameň.

ref: Not gonna lie, you had been searching your wallet for ages before you grinned like a wealthy man.
sk: Nebudem klamať, ty si prehľadával svoju peňaženku celú večnosť, kým si sa uškrnul ako bohatý muž.

ref: Her roof is a flat roof, not a tiled roof.
sk: Jej strecha je plochá strecha, nie strecha s taškami.

ref: What is behind them? A huge green wave.
sk: Čo je za nimi? Obrovská zelená vlna.

ref: The water in the pool is warm and blue.
sk: Voda v bazéne je teplá a modrá.

ref: He puts the cap on his hot head.
sk: Šiltovku si dá na horúcu hlavu.

ref: She usually works alone, but today she is introducing herself to the team.
sk: Ona zvyčajne pracuje sama, ale dnes sa predstavuje tímu.

ref: The whole runway walk was filmed on three phones at the same time.
sk: Celá chôdza po móle bola natočená naraz na tri telefóny.

ref: If you sit in a waiting room, you wait because that is what the room is for.
sk: Keď sedíš v čakárni, ty čakáš, lebo na to tá miestnosť je.

ref: There are many leaves for one broom, because trees drop leaves.
sk: Na jednu metlu je veľa lístia, lebo stromy púšťajú lístie.

ref: He was hunting for a socket when she suddenly pointed at the wall behind the monstera.
sk: Zháňal zásuvku, keď zrazu ukázala na stenu za monsterou.

ref: She really runs this greenhouse, doesn't she?
sk: Ten skleník naozaj vedie ona, však?

ref: He had been waiting for approval for months before this unbelievable moment!
sk: Na schválenie čakal celé mesiace pred touto neuveriteľnou chvíľou!

ref: She admitted carrying one small piece of fruit, but not a whole spiky durian.
sk: Priznala, že vezie jeden malý kúsok ovocia, ale nie celý ostnatý durián.

ref: Who lies down beside the tiger? The clown.
sk: Kto si ľahne vedľa tigra? Klaun.

ref: Who will lie down beside the tiger? The clown.
sk: Kto si ľahne vedľa tigra? Klaun.

ref: By the final whistle, the subject will have cheered enthusiastically for approximately 90 minutes.
sk: Do záverečného hvizdu subjekt bude povzbudzovať nadšene približne 90 minút.

ref: Nobody can wait here without getting bored.
sk: Nikto tu nevie čakať a nenudiť sa.

ref: The artist had smoothed the stripes with a sponge before she used the brush.

sk: Baby, počula som, že návrat našej obľúbenej cestovateľky bol dnes.

sk: Autá opravuje každý deň, ale teraz práve nakúka pod kapotu.
